content:
The **Cold Shoulder** is a legendary Double-Barrel Shotgun in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt* season.

Craftable legendary Double-Barrel Shotgun. Quad, Cryo (reduced movement speed for 4 seconds, adds Cryo Damage,) Paranormal (+50% Damage to Cryptids).

Can only be crafted at a Weapons Workbench.
